conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Check current state
cursor.execute("SELECT status, shipping_status FROM orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-E0E671'")
row = dict(cursor.fetchone())
print(f"Current state: status={row['status']}, shipping={row['shipping_status']}")

if row['status'] in ('pending', 'confirmed'):
    # Execute cancellation
    cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE orders
        SET status = 'cancelled',
            shipping_status = 'cancelled',
            cancel_reason = 'Customer requested cancellation'
        WHERE order_id = 'ORD-E0E671'
    """)
    cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE order_items
        SET item_status = 'cancelled'
        WHERE order_id = 'ORD-E0E671'
    """)
    conn.commit()
    print("Cancellation committed.")
else:
    print(f"Order already in state: {row['status']}")

# Final verification - full details
cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-E0E671'")
order = dict(cursor.fetchone())

cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = 'ORD-E0E671'")
items = [dict(r) for r in cursor.fetchall()]

cursor.execute("SELECT preferred_refund_method, payment_methods_json, name, email FROM users WHERE user_id = ?", (order['customer_id'],))
user = dict(cursor.fetchone())
payment_methods = json.loads(user['payment_methods_json'])
pm = payment_methods.get(order['payment_method'], {})

print(json.dumps({
    "customer": {
        "name": user["name"],
        "email": user["email"],
        "preferred_refund_method": user["preferred_refund_method"]
    },
    "order": {
        "order_id": order["order_id"],
        "order_date": order["order_date"],
        "status": order["status"],
        "shipping_status": order["shipping_status"],
        "cancel_reason": order["cancel_reason"],
        "total_paid": order["total_paid"],
        "payment_method_id": order["payment_method"],
        "payment_card_brand": pm.get("brand"),
        "payment_card_last_four": pm.get("last_four")
    },
    "items": [
        {
            "item_id": i["oi_id"],
            "name": i["name"],
            "quantity": i["quantity"],
            "unit_price": i["unit_price"],
            "status": i["item_status"]
        } for i in items
    ]
}, indent=2))

conn.close()
'''
await write_file("./final_cancel.py", final_cancel_script)
print("Script written")

final_out = await run_command("python ./final_cancel.py")
print(final_out)
